title: Adding documents
description: Attach manuals, receipts, and registration to your boat.

steps.text: Open the boat hub and go to Documents.
Tap Add and pick a photo or file.
Add a name and expiry date if it applies.

tips: Add your engine manual here to power Manual extraction.
Useful for insurance, registration, and receipts.
affects: Feed the dashboard, intervals, and cost insights.
examples: Attaching the owner manual for manual extraction.
